title: Design System: Veer macOS AI Editor

native.units: SwiftUI logical points; pt tokens are not CSS pixel measurements
native.authority: User-approved OpenCode reference prototype followed by 开始落地; authorized native documentation refresh within the incumbent Veer visual world.

semanticColors.name: accent
semanticColors.purpose: Veer accent; platform-owned selection and control states

semanticColors.name: secondary
semanticColors.purpose: Supporting text, metadata and line numbers

semanticColors.name: error
semanticColors.purpose: Error status; deletion uses red opacity(0.08) background, not colored body

semanticColors.name: window
semanticColors.purpose: Detail background and user prompt bubble

semanticColors.name: operation-material
semanticColors.purpose: Native glass, older-OS material or reduced-transparency solid fallback

typography.name: header-section
typography.purpose: File header, review, routing destinations and YAML Diff

typography.name: supporting
typography.value: .callout; medium for completion, semibold for file entry

typography.name: metadata
typography.purpose: Status, regions, limitations / expanded rule matches

typography.name: diff
typography.purpose: Single-line Diff and before/after line numbers

typography.name: import-symbol
typography.purpose: SF Symbols plus only; not a body font scale

layout.composition: Balanced NavigationSplitView; native sidebar; single-line imported filename/actions; conversation + on-demand review; composer fixed at bottom of conversation column

review.measurement: GeometryReader detail width, not whole window width
review.compact: Single visible review region over mounted full-size conversation; opacity 0, hit testing disabled and accessibilityHidden true

layout.diff: 36pt before/after columns; 240pt scroll viewport; unwrapped horizontal scroll
layout.composerHeightMeaning: 72pt input area, or minimum import-prompt height; not whole container height
layout.responsiveBehavior: Width-based native presentation and scrolling; no mobile breakpoint

native.elevation: Solid content, separator strokeBorder 0.5pt, no custom shadows. OperationGlass checks system Reduce Transparency/user opaque preference first, then macOS 26 glassEffect(.regular), else regularMaterial. Prominent/utility actions use native glass or bordered fallbacks. Import action uses circular interactive glass. macOS 14 and system Reduce Transparency source branches are not runtime verified.
native.shapes: Frontmatter panel for composer/content/operations, field for prompt bubble/file entry/review; platform-owned field and control shapes; circular import action
native.motion: No custom animation or motion tokens
native.previewPolicy: Preserve native SwiftUI metadata. No HTML/CSS previews, sampled semantic-color hex, guessed system font sizes or synthesized tonal ramps; browser panel previews cannot faithfully express this native implementation.
native.privacy: Full imported source stays in local memory and loopback service, never AI context. AI receives anonymous outlets, regions and anonymized prompt. Prompt explicitly warns against secrets; arbitrary user-entered secrets cannot be guaranteed to be detected. Keychain status restores booleans only, never secret values into UI. Confirmation changes draft only; no Controller/VPN or proxy reload.
native.serviceDependency: App bundles Node, editing service and placeholder validator; authenticated random 127.0.0.1 port; app owns lifecycle; external npm start no longer required

evidence.review: Scoped independent native UI SHIP; mapped states and persistence approved, no pending mechanical UI findings. No browser/CSS detector used.
verified: Release build and ad-hoc signature verification
No-node/no-key fixture import, local generation, confirm and undo guards
Per-turn range disclosure remains on across confirm and close/reopen
History scroll value 0.4880382775119617 before and after compact review
Complete native export YAML parsed: current 10 Netflix/ChatGPT US service rules + MATCH; non-rules prefix preserved byte-for-byte
Separate user dirty old window preserved
unverified: Real AI and long-running AI request

historical.evidence: 9 tests; light 1120 × 860pt, navigation/candidate persistence, confirm, independent rules sync and undo; dark/exact minimum/export unverified at that time

historical.layout: Import canvas and single-column conversation before on-demand review
historical.evidence: Light/dark import canvas, file/public HTTPS YAML, 10-rule preview/confirm, complete export; Node 43, Swift 20 passed and 1 fixture skipped. Historical checks, not rerun claims.

components.name: Import action
components.states: Native interactive glass/material/opaque fallback; disabled busy; ⌘O and explicit accessibility label

components.name: Utility actions
components.purpose: Import, undo, export, review and appearance
components.states: Native button states, help/semantic label, action-specific guards and shortcuts

components.name: Composer
components.swiftUI: Solid TextEditor + segmented mode Picker + native send/cancel/follow controls
components.purpose: Post-import instruction input; pre-import guidance only
components.states: 72pt input; no send before import; busy conflicts guarded; secret warning

components.name: Native settings field
components.purpose: AI endpoint/model and non-restored secret input
components.states: Native focus; endpoint-isolated saved-Key boolean status

components.name: Conversation turn
components.purpose: Prompt, actual processing disclosure, response, service/outlet summary
components.states: Three real successful records; running elapsed timer; failure/cancel retry; no model reasoning

components.name: File entry
components.purpose: Open same turn in on-demand review
components.states: State title and chevron; explicit per-file accessibility label

components.name: On-demand review
components.states: Selected turn survives close; per-turn route disclosure survives confirm; only current valid pending confirmation; only matching stack-top undo

components.name: Diff
components.purpose: Single-line rule differences with independent before/after numbers
components.states: + / − and subtle add/remove backgrounds, primary text, selection and copy

components.name: Transient feedback
components.purpose: Nonbusy feedback without reserved height; persistent inline error recovery
components.states: Normal 4s/error 8s, manual close, repeated message resets lifetime; running state uses turn/cancel

narrative.northStar: 清晰安静可靠的工作台
narrative.overview:
Veer 的 macOS 界面是原生 SwiftUI 工作台，不是网页包装。品牌承诺来自 `PRODUCT.md`：清晰、安静、可靠，保留绿色标识，沿用 macOS 原生控件与系统语义色。信息、编辑和审阅优先于装饰；不照搬 Android 卡片语言。

用户已确认 OpenCode 参考原型并要求「开始落地」。本次在既有视觉世界内刷新设计记录：保留导入画布，导入后以主对话承载指令、真实任务记录、出口摘要与紧凑文件条目，详细审阅按需打开。内容保持实底，Liquid Glass 只用于操作层与动作。原型是布局参考，不是运行证据；原生源码与本轮真实应用截图才是当前实现依据。
keyCharacteristics: 原生控件、系统文字角色、语义色。
主对话与按需审阅，紧凑窗口一次呈现一个主要区域。
玻璃只在操作层，正文保持清晰稳定。
出口、验证限制与差异先于确认动作。
操作结果明确停留在规则草稿，不暗示代理已经生效。

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: 保留系统语义色与原生材质，不将其冻结为截图采样 hex，不生成未经平台定义的 tonal ramp。

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: 延续系统文本角色和 monospaced 设计，不引入固定字体尺寸或网页字体栈作为原生实现规范。

rules.name: The Native Surface Rule
rules.body: 内容面板保持实底可读，玻璃只属于操作层，不给正文、编辑器或 Diff 叠加透明材质和装饰性投影。

dos: Do 复用系统语义色、文字角色、原生控件与现有 spacing scale。
Do 先呈现明确出口、验证限制与 Diff，再允许确认规则草稿。
Do 用文字、图标、行号和 Diff 前缀补足颜色的状态含义。
Do 保留选中 turn、匹配范围展开与历史阅读位置，以同一 model 驱动审阅。
Do 保留草稿范围、未实测地区、占位检查与内存存储的真实限制。
donts: Don't 从截图发明固定 hex、字体尺寸、阴影、tonal ramp 或动画 token。
Don't 给规则、Diff 正文或内容面板加玻璃；Diff 保持 primary 正文与 + / − 前缀。
Don't 把 Android 卡片或网页导航视觉直接移植到原生工作台。
Don't 将「确认修改」写成连接代理、应用配置或真实出口已经验证。
Don't 将原型演示阶段、源码兼容分支或 accessibility label 当成已完成的运行验证。
Don't 在紧凑审阅时移除或压缩原对话，或让被隐藏的对话继续接受点击与辅助技术访问。
